# Justification Ground

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:JustificationGround`](gmeow-JustificationGround.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/JustificationGround>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/epistemics`](../../slices/epistemics.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The class of things that can serve as a justification basis — an evidence span, an attestation, or a further doxastic state. Introduced as a named superclass so that schema projections can assign a single range to [`gmeow:justifiedBy`](../properties/gmeow-justifiedBy.md) instead of losing a blank-node [owl:unionOf.](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#unionOf.)

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`owl:Thing`](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:JustificationGround`](gmeow-JustificationGround.md) as a specialized kind of [`owl:Thing`](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the range of [`gmeow:justifiedBy`](../properties/gmeow-justifiedBy.md) when projecting the ontology into schema languages that cannot consume a blank-node [owl:unionOf.](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#unionOf.)

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it as an independent kind of entity; it is a schema-friendly union category whose instances are always EvidenceSpans, Attestations, or DoxasticStates.

### How to use

- Let instances be typed as [`gmeow:EvidenceSpan`](gmeow-EvidenceSpan.md), [`gmeow:Attestation`](gmeow-Attestation.md), or [`gmeow:DoxasticState`](gmeow-DoxasticState.md); the explicit subClassOf axioms make them gmeow:JustificationGrounds for downstream schemas.

### Examples

- ex:aliceBelievesRound [`gmeow:justifiedBy`](../properties/gmeow-justifiedBy.md) ex:photoEvidence, ex:expertAttestation, ex:bobBelievesRound.
